heroHeadline: Dueling Trench Protests and a Concluded Maritime Hearing Mark a Quiet But Tense Week
heroSubtitle: Cambodia protested Thai trench-digging near Boundary Pillar No. 9 in Oddar Meanchey on September 15, while separately the Thai Army said Cambodia agreed on September 17 to fill in a trench and remove wire it had dug near Hill 450 in Si Sa Ket -- a resolution reached through direct liaison-team dialogue. The first UNCLOS maritime boundary conciliation session between the two countries concluded in Singapore on September 16 after three days of opening statements, with roughly 12 months ahead for the non-binding process. A newer World Vision displacement count puts civilians still unable to return home at 20,923 as of July 2026, down from the December 2025 peak of 644,589. The December 27 ceasefire continues to hold in form.
